index_line: - [[totem-acoustic-signature-one]] — 8 Ω, sens 83.0 dB (claimed 87.5), min Z 7.7 Ω, no spinorama; panel/port resonances 490-700 Hz (NRC, Stereophile)
source_index_lines: - [[stereophile-totem-acoustic-signature-one]] — Stereophile measurements by J. Atkinson, 2017-12-28 (Tier B)
brand_notes: Totem (Montreal) Signature One replaced the Model 1 Signature in 2017; 6.5 in woofer, 1 in Al dome, rear port, 8 Ω (earlier Model 1 was 4 Ω). Hand-built crossovers, long break-in recommended (150 h per manual). Measured sensitivity is about 4 dB below claim (nrc/stereophile). Rainmaker is in Totem's Legacy list; Loon Monitor $1,300 has no Tier A/B data.
takeaways: Measured sensitivity 83.0 dB (NRC) / 83.5 dB (Stereophile) vs 87.5 dB claimed
Easy impedance: 7.4-7.7 Ω min near 200 Hz, no flag
Cabinet resonances at 490/600 Hz and port-pipe modes to 700 Hz (Stereophile); matches Reichert's 500-600 Hz complaint
Wide even horizontal dispersion to 6 kHz; vertical suckout above tweeter axis
No spinorama, f3, LW deviation or preference score; f3 left null
conflicts: Crossover 2.5 kHz (maker) vs 2.7 kHz (Stereophile text) vs 3.5 kHz measured
Bass: claimed 45 Hz vs NRC LW falling through -3 dB near 85 Hz (graph-read)
